verdict.reason: The finding claims every checkbox under Tasks 1-3 is unchecked ([ ]) and that Review says '_Filled in when the PR lands._'. Reading the actual file (docs/tasks/active/20260917-wafflebase-doc-store-todo.md) shows the opposite: every task item, including Scope, Task 1 (1.1-1.8), Task 2 (2.1-2.6), Task 3 (3.1-3.7), and Verification, is marked [x] (checked), and the Review section (lines 208-228) contains detailed, specific prose about review findings and fixes (eviction scoping, remove() atomicity, purgeDocument addition) — not a placeholder. Only one line (195, an intentionally-struck-through historical claim about import scope) is unchecked, and it explains in-line why it was kept unchecked rather than deleted. This matches the implementation state (wafflebase-doc-store.ts, doc-store-contract.ts, and the four test files all exist and are referenced by name in the todo itself), so there is no stale/incomplete-doc contradiction here at all.
